episodes.200147: A strong low pressure tracking from northwest Ontario to the eastern UP through the day on the 28th resulted in frequent storm force gusts over the Bay of Green Bay.
episodes.200148: A strong low pressure tracking from northwest Ontario to the eastern UP through the day on the 28th resulted in a few brief storm force gusts on Lake Superior.
